methods_quotes.q: Rate ratios (RRs) and associated 95% CIs were estimated using a multivariate Poisson regression model.
The model also included the logarithm of all-cause ED visits to account as an offset term.
The 95th percentile for each region was computed based on HRI ED data recorded for the 2018–2022 warm-season months.
